en.html:
Winter was late to Aizu this year.

On the calendar, winter had already arrived. In actual practice, no. The snow that normally began whitening grass and trees around the middle of the eleventh month had not done so even once, and the twelfth month was here. Very unusual, our host had said.

Perhaps this too was bad luck. A northern landscape needed its white snow to show itself properly, surely.

The mansion’s garden was splendid, befitting a branch of the great Ootori family. Even so, something was missing. All that magnificence, and the finishing touch had not reported for duty.

The snow clouds waited at Aizu’s border.
The winds above holding them there? The currents of the sea?

Or the blood-reeking heat of the people crawling over the earth?

ja.html:
今年の会津は冬の訪れが遅い。

　暦の上では既に冬季である。
　しかし、例年通りならば霜月の中頃には降り始める
雪が、師走に入ってもまだ一度たりと草木を白く染め
ていない。珍しいことだと、家主は語っていた。

　不運なのかもしれない。そう思う。
　北国の景色は、やはり白雪の彩りを得て映えるもの
であろうから。

　屋敷内の庭園も名族大鳥家の<ruby>連枝<rt>れんし</rt></ruby>たるを示す見事な
ものではあったものの、何処か画竜点睛を欠く趣きは
否めない。

　雪雲は、会津の<ruby>國境<rt>くにざかい</rt></ruby>で足踏みしている。
　天の風向のためか海の潮流のためか。

　それとも地を這う人の発する血生臭い<ruby>熱<rt>いきれ</rt></ruby>のためか。

en.html:
Winter without white. Even the temperature was taking its time about falling.
Born in the south, not raised in the north either—I apparently had a little longer before becoming permanently attached to the heated kotatsu table, too frozen to leave.

And in that time—


————What was I to do?

Not a matter for my one-man decision.

Kageaki"Ah, Nagakura sir. A little while ago. In more than sufficient quantity."

景明「これは永倉翁。 　昼なら先程、充分に」
景明「あの柿の浸物ひたしものは絶品でした。 　どうか厨房の方かたに感謝をお伝え下さい」

en.html:
The old man said it cheerfully, white teeth showing. Full kindly-grandfather appearance.

And under that appearance, the nerve to shelter a man hunted by an army as though nothing was the matter. Not a glimpse of it on the surface.
Make an enemy of this fellow, and “trouble” would be an insultingly small word for the result.

　まさに好々爺という風情である。

からも窺えない。
　万一にも敵に回したなら、厄介では済まぬ<ruby>仁<rt>じん</rt></ruby>に違い
なかった。

en.html:
Kageaki"So those are the famous persimmons offered to the throne. To share the Emperor’s fare is a great honor."
Elder Nagakura"If they have pleased you, I shall ask for another preparation at dinner. Now, our honored guest—"
Elder Nagakura"Where are you going, then? To Kanae madam’s room, perhaps?"
Kageaki"Yes. That was my intention. If there is no objection, I would ask permission to visit her."
Elder Nagakura"...Yes, I should think it is all right now. Only, spend a little time elsewhere first."
Elder Nagakura"I do not think Kanae madam has finished her lunch yet."
Kageaki"I see. ...Of course. Then I shall do as you advise."
Elder Nagakura"After turning you away so often, now I make you wait again. My apologies."
Kageaki"Not at all. A visit that troubles the patient is merely a nuisance wearing good intentions. Each time you warned me, I was grateful."
Elder Nagakura"No, no, no. Put it like that, and you make me quite ashamed..."
Kageaki"I shall walk in your garden. Perhaps I ate too quickly; the stomach is registering some objection. A little walking can assist digestion also."

ja.html:
景明「あれが名高い献上柿。 　帝の御相伴に与れるとは光栄の至りです」
永倉翁「気に入って頂けたなら、晩にはまた趣向を 変えて出してくれるよう言っておきましょう かの。 　して御客人」
永倉翁「どちらに参られますのかな。 　もしや香奈枝様のお部屋へ？」
景明「は。そのつもりでした。 　差し支えなくば、見舞いをお許し願いたく」
永倉翁「……そうだの。もうよろしかろう。 　しかし、少々時間をつぶしてからになさり ませい」
永倉翁「香奈枝様はまだ、昼餉を終えられておらぬ と思いますでの」
景明「そうですか。……確かに。 　では、お勧めの通りに致します」
永倉翁「何度も追い払った挙句にまた待ちぼうけを 食わせて、申し訳ございませぬ」
景明「とんでもない。 　相手に迷惑を掛ける見舞いなど見舞いでは ありません。いちいちご忠告を下されたこと、 有難く思っております」
永倉翁「いやいやいや。 　そのように言われては恐縮……」
景明「御庭を歩かせて頂くことにしましょう。 　食事を急ぎ過ぎたのか、いささか胃の心地 が悪いので、腹ごなしも兼ねて」

en.html:
Elder Nagakura"...Mm. Now you mention it, you were remarkably quick."
Elder Nagakura"A family tradition, this speed?"
Kageaki"...No. Not particularly. Normally I do not... Even today, speedy completion of lunch was not an objective I had set myself."
Elder Nagakura"Unconsciously, then. Battlefield training showing itself at the dining table?"
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"It may be so."
Elder Nagakura"Enemy may arrive at any moment, and you sit enjoying each mouthful? Death will finish its meal before you finish yours. Naturally, the chopsticks hurry."
Elder Nagakura"But you need not be anxious here. Those occupation fellows surrounding this house... for the present, that is most unlikely."
Kageaki"Nagakura sir, you mean—"
Elder Nagakura"Our scouts returned a short while ago. According to them, that fellow Shishiku’s men have blocked the main routes across the border so closely, not even an ant could crawl out."
Elder Nagakura"Nothing short of bringing up a great army will get through."
Kageaki"............"
Elder Nagakura"Naturally, before very long such a situation will arise. But for a little while yet, you may put the worry aside."
Kageaki"Understood."

ja.html:
永倉翁「……むふぅ。 　そういえば、随分とお早い」
永倉翁「ご家風ですかな？」
景明「……いえ。別段。 　普段はこのような事はなく……今とて殊更 迅速な完食を心掛けたわけではないのですが」
永倉翁「では無意識に。 　戦場の心得が顕れましたのかな？」
景明「…………」
景明「そうかもしれません」
永倉翁「いつ何時、敵に襲われるか知れぬとあらば、 食事にのんびり時間を掛けるなど自殺行為も 同然ですからのう。 　箸が早まるのは当たり前」
永倉翁「しかし、ご案じ召されるな。 　当家が進駐軍の奴輩に取り巻かれるような 事は……当面、まずございますまいからの」
景明「翁、それは」
永倉翁「先刻、物見が戻って参りましてな。 　國境の要路は、獅子吼めの手勢で蟻の這い 出る隙間もなく固められているとの事」
永倉翁「大軍を起こさねば、突破は叶いますまいて」
景明「…………」
永倉翁「無論のこと、そうした事態は遠からず出来しゅったい 致しましょうがの。 　今しばらくは、ご懸念に及ばず」
景明「は」

Old Nagakura’s words made me go back over everything, willing or unwilling.
Haan—sooner or later, the occupation forces would pour into Aizu.

That was where matters had come.
